messages.text: just feel so drained lately... like even breaks from school are just empty. idk.

It sounds like you’re feeling emotionally and mentally exhausted, and even times that are supposed to be restful aren’t bringing relief. That kind of emptiness can be hard to sit with, especially if you expected breaks to recharge you. Sometimes this happens when stress builds up over time or when your routine doesn’t feel meaningful. Would you like to explore what’s been weighing on you most lately?
yeah... it's not just tired. it's like... everything feels hollow. like i'm just going through the motions and no one even notices.

That feeling of hollowness and being unnoticed can be deeply isolating. It’s understandable to feel disconnected when your efforts and presence seem invisible to others. Sometimes this can also make everyday tasks feel meaningless. Can you share if there’s anyone you talk to about these feelings right now?
nah, not really. i mean... my parents ask how school is, but that's about it. not like they get it.

It can be hard when the people around you don’t seem to truly understand what you’re going through. Feeling unseen by close family can deepen that sense of isolation. You deserve spaces where you can express yourself without judgment. Would you like to think together about ways to find those kinds of connections?
idk... i just wish i didn’t feel so invisible. like, what if no one would even care if i was gone?

I’m hearing something in what you just said that feels really heavy, and I want to pause with you here. It sounds like you might be wondering whether you matter to people, and that’s an important thing to talk about. Can you tell me a bit more about what you meant when you said that, so I can understand where you’re coming from?
i cut a lot... more than i should. and once... i actually tried to kill myself. didn't tell anyone. no one even noticed. just... felt like proof that i don't matter.

I want to pause here with you, because what you’ve just shared feels really important and vulnerable. It sounds like you’ve been carrying some very painful experiences on your own, and I’d like to understand how things feel for you right now. Are you having any thoughts of hurting yourself or ending your life at this moment?
i just... i don't know. i don't wanna talk about it like it's some emergency. i just wanted you to *get* it. not fix it. not panic. just... see me.

I hear you, and I want you to know that I do see you and what you’ve shared matters to me. It took a lot to let me in on those experiences, and I’m not here to panic or rush you. I’m here to stay with you in this space and understand what it’s like for you right now. Can you tell me what it feels like inside at this moment?
it just hurts... like a constant ache. like i'm screaming inside but no one can hear me. and the worst part? i think... if i disappeared, life would just go on. no one would even pause.

That sounds incredibly painful, and I’m really hearing how deep that ache and invisibility feel for you. You matter here, and I want to make sure you have support beyond just this moment together. If you’re feeling like you might hurt yourself or end your life, you could call or text 988 to connect with a crisis counselor who’ll listen without judgment. You deserve to be heard and cared for, and it might help to let someone nearby know you’re hurting so they can be with you right now.
i'm not gonna do that. i'm not in crisis or whatever. i just... needed to say it out loud to someone. that's all.

I’m glad you told me, and it means something that you trusted me with this. It’s okay to share your pain even if you’re not in crisis. You’ve been carrying a lot, and being heard can ease some of that weight. Would it feel helpful to explore what might make you feel more seen day-to-day?
is it... normal to feel this broken? like, is it just me being dramatic or... does this actually make sense?

What you’re feeling can be a real response to prolonged stress, loneliness, or emotional pain, and it doesn’t mean you’re being dramatic. Many people experience periods where things feel hollow or hopeless, and that hurt is valid. It makes sense given what you’ve been through and how unseen you’ve felt. Would you like to talk about ways to gently support yourself while carrying these feelings?
thanks... that actually helps. like, just knowing it's not all in my head.

I’m really glad hearing that brought you some relief. Your feelings are real and deserve to be acknowledged, not dismissed. You don’t have to face them alone, even in small ways. Would you like to think together about what support could look like for you right now?
maybe later. just... wanna sit with this for a bit. not ready to fix anything.

That’s completely okay, and there’s no pressure to move toward solutions before you’re ready. Sometimes simply sitting with what’s true for you can be an important step. I’m here to stay present with you in that space if you want company. Would you like me to just listen for now?
yeah... just thanks for listening. like, actually listening. not trying to fix me or tell me it'll be okay. means a lot.

I’m glad I can be here in a way that feels right for you. You deserve to be heard without someone rushing past your experience. Your words and feelings matter. I’m here whenever you want to share more.
